_comment: BUG-92 component floor (opt-in). Copy to component-floor.json (drop the .example) to ACTIVATE. Keyed by page kind (service | city | blog), each value a list of markers seo-qa requires on a built page of that kind. Each marker is tried as a case-insensitive regex, falling back to a substring. seo-qa hard-fails a page built THIS run that is missing any marker for its kind. Absent file = no floor gate.
